mission.missionName: Artemis VII Deep Space Orbital Habitat

astronauts.name: Elena Rostova
astronauts.notes: Demonstrates high microgravity cardiovascular tolerance. Experienced transient nocturnal SpO2 dip on Sol 141 during ECLSS Node-2 filter replacement. Prescribed 2.5h daily CEVIS/ARED countermeasure protocol.

astronauts.name: Alex Chen
astronauts.notes: First long-duration mission. Completed neurovestibular motion sickness adaptation without pharmacological antiemetics. Excellent exercise countermeasure compliance.

astronauts.name: Dr. Marcus Vance
astronauts.notes: Expedition 74 Crew Medical Officer (CMO). Tracks cephalad fluid shift via ultrasound jugular vein dimension protocols. Mild circadian phase delay observed due to night-shift Earth ground link tele-operations.

astronauts.name: Dr. Samantha Reed
astronauts.mission: Artemis VII Deep Space Orbital Habitat
astronauts.notes: Subject dynamically ingested via flight telemetry upload. Registered into active Expedition 74 health matrix.

alerts.reason: Peripheral oxygen saturation dropped below mandatory spaceflight safety limit (93.0%).
alerts.physiologicalMechanism: Potential ventilation-perfusion mismatch in microgravity, hypobaric hypoxia, or localized cabin atmosphere stratification with elevated localized carbon dioxide.
alerts.suggestedAction: Verify cabin Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) ppO2/ppCO2 sensors immediately. Have crewmember reposition pulse oximeter probe and administer supplemental O2 if uncorrected within 5 minutes.

alerts.reason: Peripheral oxygen saturation dipped below NASA STD-3001 safety envelope (93.0%) during Node-2 ECLSS maintenance cycle.
alerts.physiologicalMechanism: Transient ventilation-perfusion shift or localized carbon dioxide micro-pocketing around maintenance rack.
alerts.suggestedAction: Flight surgeon confirmed cabin atmosphere scrubber realignment. Pulse oximetry normalized to 98.0%. Continue continuous SpO2 monitoring for next 12 hours.
